sourceQuote: 6. Certificate of English proficiency test 6.0 or above for IELTS; 80 or above for TOEFL;or other certificates which can prove that the applicant is a native English speaker or English is his/her working language at college.
targetQuote: 6. 英语水平测试证书6.0或以上适用于IELTS；80或以上适用于TOEFL；或其他可证明申请人为英语母语者，或大学期间以英语为工作语言的证书。
